result.detail: Section 5 of the microarchitecture plans skid_buffer.sby and skid_buffer_w1.sby for an unbounded proof. This task's expected outputs are rtl_source and testbench only, so I have not written the formal job files. They should be a follow-on task, or this task should be widened if the tech lead wants them here. I added `timescale 1ns/1ps to both files so Verilator does not raise TIMESCALEMOD. Testbench check IDs are listed in comments in skid_buffer_tb.v. The stimulus uses a deterministic xorshift generator, so both simulators see the same traffic. A run that does not finish within 20000 cycles counts as one failure and still prints the verdict.
